messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-5021) 0— cache-miss storms generated ~80 pages in 15m. We need a new paging policy + adaptive thresholds to cut noise without losing real incidents.
alex: Proposal sketch: move low-impact spikes to Slack-only for the first 3m unless combined signals indicate severity (sustained or large host-fanout). If sustained, escalate to pager. :thinking:
tom: +1 in principle. Concern: short quarantines might hide slow ramps. Suggest tiered escalation: Slack-only -> Pager after sustain window (e.g., 3m slack, 10m pager) OR if affected_hosts > 5 immediately pager.
li: I'll own runbook updates and examples. Also: when deduping, don't collapse across different owner groups (so we don't hide per-team responsibility). Dedupe key = (service, error_class, host_group).
maria: Draft rules and heuristics: 1) baseline = median(30m) metric 2) trigger = increase(metric[2m]) > baseline * factor 3) initial delivery = slack for 3m 4) pager if persists for 10m or affected_hosts > threshold.
alex: Example Prometheus-style rule to start with:
```
alert: cache_miss_spike
expr: increase(cache_misses_total[2m]) > (avg_over_time(cache_misses_total[30m]) * 5)
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "Cache miss spike for {{ $labels.service }}"
```
For pager rules we add `severity: critical` and `for: 10m` and `affected_hosts > 5` check in the alertproxy middleware.
tom: Metrics we should add: `alerts.paging_policy.switched.count` (tags: service, region, from, to) and `alerts.suppressed.count`. Also a dashboard panel showing alerts -> pages ratio over time. I'll build the Grafana panels.
maria: Rollout plan: push policy to staging, run synthetic bursts across services, observe 48h in staging, then canary to us-west for 72h, then global. If pages drop >60% with no missed SLOs, proceed.
li: Owner matrix + ETAs:
- maria: policy definition + alertproxy middleware PR (ETA: Fri)
- alex: metrics + Grafana panels + synthetic traffic harness (ETA: Tue)
- tom: staging tests + canary automation (ETA: Wed)
- li: runbook + playbook + oncall notes (ETA: Thu)
alert-bot: Created follow-up task INC-5021 and assigned to maria.
alex: I'll run a quick staging mock tonight and post graphs in this thread. ping me if you want to be on the test.
li: Reminder to update the oncall rotation note with the new paging thresholds and the revert checklist.
maria: Thanks, team. We'll reconvene Mon 10:00 to review staging output and decide go/no-go.
